title: dsh and optimizer adapter boundary
audience: Agents and maintainers planning dsh, Cordis, GEPA, SkillOpt, or evaluation integration

claims.text: Default dsh integration uses repository instructions and project-local skill discovery; optional plugin source and user-global deployment do not alter a shared profile or home configuration without their separate exact approvals.

Cordis run, improvement, quarantined HMR-staging, and G2 packages ship as workspace source only; profile installation or mounting remains opt-in and separately approved. Awaited session flushes are durable, while observe-only disposal leaves final recorder persistence unproved.

The SkillOpt-shaped prepare/evaluate adapter is deterministic and provider-neutral; GEPA and SkillOpt optimizer runtimes do not run in v0, and HMR plugin candidate application is unavailable pending authoritative imported-closure identity and awaited readiness.
Promptfoo is the primary future CI experiment candidate; PyRIT and Langfuse or Phoenix remain optional red-team or observability adapters, not installed v0 dependencies or authority sources.
The inspected DSH version has pre-execute, execute, and post-execute tool waterfalls; its final tools/result notification is observation-only, not a fourth enforcement waterfall.

A future DSH evaluation adapter must flush and pin the selected Turn, Step, tool, and approval event range and verify external side effects independently; event replay is not side-effect reproduction.
DSH sandbox evidence is runner-, platform-, and mode-specific and does not by itself establish network isolation; future DAL claims remain limited to the controls actually exercised.

The run-to-run controller foundation is an offline observation subsystem separate from proposal lifecycle; an optional unmounted recorder bridge can supply pinned closed terminal observations, while PI governance, response learning, predictive selection, canary, and rollback control remain future work.

DAL ships the runtime manifest/evidence contract, recorder consumer, and controller verifier; authoritative effective Loader configuration, resolver receipts, artifact closure, transition sequencing, and readiness remain owned by a future pinned DSH launcher service.

retrieval_pointers.when: Changing how dal participates in a dsh project
Making a claim about dsh, Cordis, GEPA, SkillOpt, or evaluated OSS options
Proposing production plugin deployment, optimizer execution, broader candidate application, provider expansion, or supply-chain integration
Designing DSH tool interception, permission escalation, trajectory evaluation, or telemetry export
Implementing generation identity, Loader mutation binding, resolver evidence, or session stability

limits: Pinned upstream interfaces are pre-stable and require fresh source inspection before integration.
The unavailable expected local SkillOpt checkout remains an evidence gap.

No authoritative DSH runtime-generation producer, HMR readiness or imported-closure identity, final-disposal durability, mounted plugin, optimizer runtime, model behavior, external evaluator, or full dsh lifecycle integration is proved by this capsule.
